title: Panda in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- scarf ends -->
  <path d='M30 66 L20 84 L30 84 L38 68 Z' fill='#e84a5f'/>
  <path d='M58 68 L70 86 L60 86 L50 68 Z' fill='#e84a5f'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='24' ry='20' fill='#f2f2f5'/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='70' rx='7' ry='12' fill='#3b3b52' transform='rotate(15 27 70)'/>
  <ellipse cx='73' cy='70' rx='7' ry='12' fill='#3b3b52' transform='rotate(-15 73 70)'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='89' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#3b3b52'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='89' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#3b3b52'/>
  <!-- scarf band -->
  <path d='M26 62 Q50 72 74 62 L74 68 Q50 78 26 68 Z' fill='#ff5c72'/>
  <!-- scarf knot -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='67' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#ff7d8e'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='26' fill='#f2f2f5'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='20' r='9' fill='#3b3b52'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='20' r='9' fill='#3b3b52'/>
  <!-- eye patches -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='40' rx='9' ry='11' fill='#3b3b52' transform='rotate(-20 38 40)'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='40' rx='9' ry='11' fill='#3b3b52' transform='rotate(20 62 40)'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='39' cy='41' r='3.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='41' r='3.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='39.5' cy='41.5' r='2' fill='#3b3b52'/>
  <circle cx='61.5' cy='41.5' r='2' fill='#3b3b52'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='4.5' ry='3' fill='#3b3b52'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 55 Q46 60 43 57' stroke='#c8c8d4' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 55 Q54 60 57 57' stroke='#c8c8d4' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='52' r='4' fill='#ffb3c1'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='52' r='4' fill='#ffb3c1'/>
</svg>
